blurb: Bucktown Marina offers fisherman and private boat slip rentals including dock box and running water. Facilities include portable bathrooms, three shelters with lights and tables, large open green spaces, a boardwalk with nature displays and benches, and a walking trail along the lake. Shelters require a minimum three-hour rental with one hour free setup; alcohol use requires a police detail.
extraNote: All facilities are a three hour minimum with a one hour free set-up included · Alcohol requires a police detail at $40 an hour with a 4 hour minimum · All bookings hosted after 7pm require a police detail · Park users must rent a shelter if the use of a spacewalk or party equipment is used · Park users must rent a shelter if they are boiling seafood · Bucktown Marina, Metairie Hammond Highway, Metairie, LA 70005
